accepted_for: Visual planning of planes, anatomical relationships and material placement; NOT accepted as exact geometric ground truth or artistically approved production character
canonical_priority: The frozen specification wins over generated-image inconsistencies. No enlargement of the frozen width or high tail curl is allowed in the mesh.

consistency.horn_count_and_laterality: Two; long anatomical left is viewer right in front and viewer left in rear. Pass.
consistency.ear_eye_placement: Two ears, lateral eyes under brows. Front and side differ in brow width; canonical skull width43.
consistency.limbs: Four. Side drawing uses staggered stance rather than exact orthographic neutral pose; canonical paired landmarks are used.
consistency.toes: Hero and turnaround-v1 include four-toe forepaws. Targeted edit v2 corrects the clearly visible paws to three. Occluded far toes cannot all be counted; mesh has exactly12 independently named toes/claws.
consistency.proportions: Front forequarters/paws are too wide relative to height. Do not anisotropically warp images or expand geometry to improve overlap. Canonical width92, shoulder72, waist42.
consistency.tail: Generated side tail tip is aboutZ107 rather than81; rear curvature also disagrees. Canonical root[0,76,83], tip[26,190,81] overrides images.
consistency.plates: Five low dorsal shields identifiable in rear; side silhouettes overlap. Shoulder cap is interpreted as one two-layer assembly per side, not extra dorsal shields.
consistency.color: Mottled texture is not modeled. Eight frozen face-color materials apply identically to both runs; native lighting will differ from painted illumination.
consistency.coordinate_label_conflict: The frozen specification calls X creature-right but assigns anatomical-left horn X=-19. The front native camera displays negativeX on viewer-left, whereas generated FRONT shows the long horn viewer-right. Both meshes preserve the identical explicit numeric horn coordinates; the anatomical label/image laterality conflict is unresolved and is not hidden by mirroring final renders.

front.uncertainty: Estimated +/-4pixels for landmarks; width conflict is genuine, not fitted away

left.uncertainty: Pose is slightly three-quarter and rear feet are staggered

rear.uncertainty: Tail occludes centerline; front and rear stances differ

limitations: Generated art was automatically displayed by the image tool. Final model labels are randomized and concealed, but user exposure to the concept can weaken blinding. The maker cannot be blinded; there is one sequential trial per method.
reference_setup_timing: Calibrated reference planes were packed in the fifth successful concept iteration, after initial numeric landmark modeling. This differs from the requested planes-before-modeling order and limits this pilot.
